official.deadline_note: There is no central applicant deadline. CNPq publishes the final list of eligible institutions in December 2026, and from December 2026 each selected institution runs its own candidate selection and sets its own deadlines.
official.status_note: The Call Notice was released on 29 June 2026; institutions submitted proposals to CNPq until 13 August 2026; the preliminary list of selected institutions is due November 2026 and the final list December 2026, after which institutions select candidates and scholarships run from March 2027 to March 2028.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The award is a monthly stipend only; no tuition fee waiver is published for PEC-PG.
benefits: Monthly stipend - R$ 2,100.00 for Master's degree (duration of 24 months) and R$ 3,100.00 for Doctorate degree (duration of 48 months)
Access to the Brazilian Public Health System (SUS) throughout Brazil, on the same conditions as Brazilian citizens, without discrimination based on nationality or immigration status

Financial aid to return to the country of origin, paid by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs depending on budgetary and financial availability, with the amount varying by country of origin per the table attached to MRE Ordinance No. 572/2024

Not have Brazilian nationality (not having dual Brazilian nationality nor the right to it)
Not have a permanent residence permit for Brazil
Have completed a higher education course equivalent to an undergraduate degree (graduação)
Not be taking, in Brazil, another course of the same level that you intend to take in PEC-PG
Have a clean record, with no debts with CAPES or the Brazilian government
Have an updated CV on the Lattes platform
Meet the specific requirements of the Graduate Program (PPG) of interest, including language requirements
requirements: Wait until December 2026 for CNPq to publish the list of eligible Higher Education and Science and Technology Institutions (HEIs/ICTs)
Check which Graduate Programs (PPGs) are included and what their specific requirements are
Contact the institutions of interest, or access their websites, to find out how to apply for a PEC-PG scholarship
Apply directly to the institution's own selection process and await its results
Comply with the Call Notice rules and the specific requirements of the chosen graduate programme

selection_criteria: Two-stage selection: CNPq first approves the eligible institutions, then each institution conducts its own selection of candidates

Access to the Brazilian public health system (SUS) on the same conditions as Brazilian citizens
Possible return-to-country-of-origin travel aid paid by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, subject to budgetary and financial availability
application_method: From December 2026, consult the CNPq list of eligible HEIs/ICTs
Check the graduate programmes (PPGs) included and their specific requirements
Contact the chosen institution and apply directly to its PEC-PG selection process

official.application_route: Apply directly to a Brazilian institution that appears on CNPq's eligible-institutions list from December 2026; the Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not receive PEC-PG applications
official.citizenship_residency: Must be a national of and live in one of the countries participating in the PEC-PG Programme; Brazilian nationality (including dual nationality or the right to it) and Brazilian permanent residence are excluded
official.international_eligibility: Open to nationals of participating countries who are not Brazilian and do not hold Brazilian permanent residence
official.research_requirement: A research project in Portuguese, Spanish or English must be submitted, and the chosen graduate programme's specific requirements apply
official.duration: 24 months for a Master's degree; 48 months for a Doctorate degree
official.description: PEC-PG is the Brazilian postgraduate exchange programme run by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs with CNPq, open to nationals of participating countries. Scholarships are paid by the receiving institutions from March 2027 to March 2028, and applicants apply through each institution's own selection process after CNPq publishes the eligible-institutions list in December 2026.
official.program_type: Government scholarship (Brazilian postgraduate exchange programme run by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs with CNPq)

applicant_utility.summary: This is a monthly stipend, not a tuition waiver: budget for Brazilian postgraduate tuition and your own airfare to Brazil out of pocket. Nothing can be submitted until CNPq publishes the eligible-institutions list in December 2026, so use the intervening months to build a Lattes CV, secure an ORCID, and draft a research project in Portuguese, Spanish or English. Because selection happens entirely inside each chosen graduate programme, your real audience is that programme's coordinators, not Itamaraty or CNPq.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Master's and doctoral candidates from participating Latin American and other countries who already have a research topic that fits a specific Brazilian graduate programme and can wait for institution-level selection from December 2026.
application_readiness_checklist: Create or update your Lattes CV in Portuguese and register an ORCID iD before December 2026
Shortlist eligible graduate programmes as soon as CNPq publishes the December 2026 list, and read each programme's own language and document requirements
Draft the research project in Portuguese, Spanish or English and align it with the supervisor's research line
Request the employer statement (in Portuguese, Spanish or English) confirming your stay will not exceed the maximum period for thesis or dissertation defence
Obtain proof of residence abroad (utility bill) and your CPF registration status proof early, since both are required to start receiving the scholarship
common_rejection_risks: Any Brazilian nationality, dual nationality or permanent residence automatically disqualifies you
Outstanding debts to CAPES or the Brazilian government disqualify you
Holding a previous full or sandwich Master's or doctoral scholarship from a Brazilian federal public entity bars the corresponding level
Missing the selected institution's own deadline from December 2026, because there is no central application window
Failing the graduate programme's specific language requirement, which PEC-PG itself does not set or waive
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition fees of the Brazilian graduate programme, international airfare to Brazil, and everyday living costs beyond the R$2,100-3,100 monthly stipend; the MRE return-travel aid is conditional on budget availability and is not guaranteed.
document_audit: The Lattes CV must be complete and updated in Portuguese, not merely an exported PDF in English
The research project must be in Portuguese, Spanish or English; other languages are not accepted
The employer statement must explicitly cap your stay at the maximum period allowed for the thesis or dissertation defence
Proof of residence abroad means a document such as a water or electricity bill, not a passport stamp
alerts: CNPq's preliminary institution list appears in November 2026 and the final list in December 2026; scholarships can only start between March 2027 and March 2028
The official page warns that calendar dates may change, so re-check the Call Notice before committing
The 2026 cycle ran under a CAPES notice for full and sandwich awards, so confirm which modality the 2027 institutions actually offer
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: No central submission: wait for CNPq's December 2026 institution list, then contact the chosen institution and apply through its own PEC-PG selection process, awaiting its result.
